plan: Quixera dev test scripts: memberships, money, programs and classes — Version 1, 17 Nov 2026 (Jira merged to dev as of 17 Nov morning)
environment: facility-dev.quixeraos.com · test academy UAT Cricket Academy (per workbook)

rows.scenario: A new term program asks how families pay, preselects nothing and never asks a price
rows.preconditions: Signed in as Admin Tester at UAT Cricket Academy. At least one published membership group exists (see data needed).
rows.steps:
1. Open Programs and press Create program.
2. On Basics enter name 'U10 Fielding Term', pick age group Under 10, sport Cricket, press Next.
3. On step 2 read the heading, sub-line and both options before touching anything.
4. Pick "Per class, by term" and press Next.
5. Walk through Sessions, Curriculum and Prerequisites and waivers (use the default Participation Agreement) and press Create program.
rows.expected: Step 2 heading reads "How families pay" with sub-line "How families get a place in this program's classes." Neither option is selected on arrival. Options read "Through a membership" and "Per class, by term". No step in the program wizard asks for a price. The program is created and the program page shows "Program created" with "Add a class"; the empty Classes tab says each class sets its own price.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: PR #654 calls the term tile "Term" while the ticket copy says "Per class, by term"; confirm which label is on screen is acceptable.
rows.source: QXR-648 current spec, Checks 3 and 5; web#654; QXR-900

rows.scenario: With no published membership group, the membership option is disabled and points to Memberships & Packages
rows.preconditions: Use a second test academy (or ask the team to unpublish/archive every membership group in a scratch academy) so no membership group is published. Signed in as its admin.
rows.steps:
1. Start a new program and reach How families pay.
2. Try to pick "Through a membership".
3. Press the link under it.
rows.expected: "Through a membership" cannot be picked. A line under it says a membership group is needed (ticket: "Set up a membership group first"; PR #683: "No membership group ready yet") with a link to Memberships & Packages that opens in a new tab. "Per class, by term" still works.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: which of the two lines is the final wording.

rows.scenario: A membership program must name its group and a sessions-per-week value the group sells
rows.preconditions: Published membership group 'Beginner' selling '1 a week' and '2 a week' plans (Quarterly and Annual). New program draft at How families pay.
rows.steps:
1. Pick "Through a membership" and press Next without choosing a group.
2. Pick group 'Beginner' and press Next without choosing sessions per week.
3. Open the sessions-per-week choice and read what is offered.
4. Pick 1 a week, read the price panel, press Next.
rows.expected: Step 1 refused with "Pick the membership group this program is priced under." Step 2 refused with "Pick how many sessions a week this program runs." Only the values the Beginner group sells (1 and 2 a week) are offered. A read-only panel "What families pay in the Beginner group" lists the group's prices; the admin never picks individual plans or types a price. With both set, Next moves to Sessions.

rows.scenario: How families pay locks once a running or upcoming class has a booking
rows.preconditions: Published term program 'U12 Batting Foundations' with one published upcoming class where Maya Tester has paid for Aria Tester (any Stripe 4242 enrolment).
rows.steps:
1. Open the program and press Edit, confirm.
2. Go to How families pay and read the section.
3. Try to choose "Through a membership" and save.
rows.expected: The section reads "How families pay is locked because 1 class has bookings. Move or cancel those bookings first." The change is refused with "This program has bookings, so how families pay can't change." The program stays term; Aria's place and Maya's payment are untouched.

rows.scenario: A class of a membership program can't be sold as a class place at the desk or by a family
rows.preconditions: Published membership program 'Beginner Membership' (group Beginner, 1 a week) with a published Tuesday class.
rows.steps:
1. As Desk Tester, try to enrol Aria Tester into the Tuesday class as a paid class place.
2. As Maya Tester on Members web, open the Tuesday class and look for a class price or Enroll.
rows.expected: The desk is refused with "This class is joined through a membership. Families sign up from the program's page." No invoice or charge is made. The guardian sees no class price for that class and is pointed to sign up through the program's membership.

rows.scenario: A class is named as its program plus a suffix prefilled from the chosen days
rows.preconditions: Published program 'U12 Batting Foundations' with no classes yet.
rows.steps:
1. On the program page press Add a class.
2. On the Schedule step tick Tuesday and Thursday and read the class name field.
3. Change the suffix to 'Tue and Thu' and read the help line.
4. Finish and save the class as a draft, then open the program page's Classes tab.
rows.expected: The name field shows the fixed prefix "U12 Batting Foundations ·" (not editable) and a suffix prefilled from the ticked days. The help line reads "Families see "U12 Batting Foundations · Tue and Thu". Leave it blank to use the program name." The class is saved as "U12 Batting Foundations · Tue and Thu". The Classes tab Class column shows the short label 'Tue and Thu'.

rows.scenario: A suffix already used in the same program is refused, ignoring case; another program may reuse it
rows.preconditions: 'U12 Batting Foundations' has a live (not cancelled, not ended) class with suffix 'Saturday Autumn'. A second program 'U10 Fielding Term' exists.
rows.steps:
1. Add a class to 'U12 Batting Foundations' and type the suffix 'saturday autumn'. Save.
2. Add a class to 'U10 Fielding Term' with suffix 'Saturday Autumn'. Save.
rows.expected: The first save is refused under the field with "U12 Batting Foundations already has a class called saturday autumn. Add a different suffix." and focus moves to the field. The second program's class saves.

rows.scenario: Renaming a program leaves class names alone; editing a suffix later uses the new program name
rows.preconditions: Class 'U12 Batting Foundations · Tue and Thu' exists.
rows.steps:
1. Edit the program and rename it to 'U12 Batting'. Save and make it live again.
2. Open the class and read its name.
3. Open the class rename dialog and change the suffix to 'Tue and Thu, 4 pm'. Save.
rows.expected: After the program rename the class still reads 'U12 Batting Foundations · Tue and Thu'. The rename dialog shows the prefix 'U12 Batting ·'. After saving the class reads 'U12 Batting · Tue and Thu, 4 pm' with no doubled prefix.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: screen location of the class rename dialog.

rows.scenario: An Adult program can be created without a Participation Agreement and its classes publish without one
rows.preconditions: No program named 'Adult Evening Nets' exists.
rows.steps:
1. Create a program 'Adult Evening Nets' with age group Adult, Per class, by term, 8 sessions, class size 4 to 10, a title for every session.
2. On Prerequisites and waivers add one prerequisite and no Participation Agreement. Press Create program.
3. Add a class with a price and publish it.
rows.expected: The program is created with no "at least one waiver" error and lands on the program page with "Program created" and "Add a class". The class publishes with no agreement error.

rows.scenario: Required documents are pre-ticked and locked on the last step; optional ones are not
rows.preconditions: Settings › Waivers has one MANDATORY waiver and one OPTIONAL waiver besides the default Participation Agreement.
rows.steps:
1. Create an Under 12 program and reach Prerequisites and waivers.
2. Try to untick the MANDATORY waiver.
3. Read the OPTIONAL waiver.
rows.expected: The MANDATORY waiver is ticked and can't be removed. The OPTIONAL one is unticked. Family-facing wording says "Participation Agreement", never "waiver".
rows.source: QXR-900 Arpit 10 Nov option A; D-086; D-015

rows.scenario: Pressing Create program twice makes one program
rows.preconditions: A complete program draft on the last step.
rows.steps:
1. Double-click Create program (or press it twice fast).
2. Open Programs and search the name.
rows.expected: The button reads "Creating program…" and the footer locks while it works. Exactly one program exists. No duplicate-name error or orphan draft appears.
rows.source: web#685 (one Idempotency-Key per create intent); web#644 follow-up

rows.scenario: Only admins reach the program wizard; another academy's program is never shown
rows.preconditions: Coach One signed in. A program id from a second test academy ({otherId}).
rows.steps:
1. As Coach One, open /programs/new/basics.
2. As Desk Tester, open the same address.
3. As Admin Tester of UAT Cricket Academy, open /programs/templates/{otherId}/setup/basics.
rows.expected: Coach One is redirected away (as the admin guard does today). Desk Tester is redirected unless the desk role is a facility admin. The admin sees "Program not found" with "It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another academy." and no data from the other academy.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: whether Desk Tester's role counts as FACILITY_ADMIN (then the desk reaches the wizard).

rows.scenario: An admin prices a class per block of sessions and a family buys the first block
rows.preconditions: Rolling admission switched on for UAT Cricket Academy. Published under-18 program 'Rolling Nets' using the default Participation Agreement. Aria has no place.
rows.steps:
1. Add a class to 'Rolling Nets'; on the price step choose next N sessions: block of 8 sessions for $240. Publish.
2. As Maya, open the class, enrol Aria and pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242.
3. Open Billing and the receipt.
rows.expected: The class sells "{price} for the next {n} sessions" style pricing, not a term. One invoice of $240.00 for block 1 is paid; receipt, Billing and class price match. Aria's block covers her next 8 sessions from her first one. No auto-continue control is shown.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: exact family wording of the block price.

rows.scenario: The next-block offer reaches the paying guardian before the block ends, never the child
rows.preconditions: Aria holds block 1 (8 sessions) in 'Rolling Nets'. Needs the clock moved to just before Aria's second-last session of the block.
rows.steps:
1. Move the clock.
2. Check Maya's email and in-app notifications, and Ravi's.
3. Check Aria's and Sam's logins (none for Aria).
rows.expected: An offer to continue with Continue and Stop arrives for the guardian by email and in-app before the second-last session. Nothing goes to an athlete under 18. A 24-hour reminder comes before the deadline.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: whether Ravi (linked, no billing) also receives the offer notice.

rows.scenario: Continue charges exactly one block even on a double click
rows.preconditions: Open next-block offer for Aria at $240.
rows.steps:
1. Press Continue twice quickly and pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242.
2. Reload Billing.
rows.expected: One block-2 invoice of $240.00 exists and is paid once. Aria's place carries on into block 2. A slow Continue may answer that it is preparing and then finish; it never charges twice.
rows.source: billing#135 (same key replays first invoice); data#345

rows.scenario: A guardian without billing permission or a 16-year-old can't continue or stop a paid block
rows.preconditions: Open next-block offer for Aria; Sam (16) holds a rolling place with an open offer.
rows.steps:
1. As Ravi, open Aria's offer and press Continue.
2. As Sam with own login, open his offer.
rows.expected: Ravi is refused (needs the billing guardian) and nothing is charged. Sam cannot continue or pay; he is told to ask a guardian.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: expected wording for Ravi and for Sam on rolling offers.
rows.source: D-105 pattern (billing permission to pay); SCH-040/041 pattern

rows.scenario: A price change on a rolling class reaches new bookings and later offers only; block size locks after a sale
rows.preconditions: 'Rolling Nets' class at $240 per 8 sessions; Aria already holds block 1 and has an open offer at $240.
rows.steps:
1. Change the block price to $280. Save.
2. Try to change the block size from 8 to 10.
3. As Maya, open Aria's open offer.
4. As another guardian, start a new enrolment.
rows.expected: Block size can't be changed once anyone has bought a block. Aria's offer still reads $240; the new family sees $280. If the class and billing prices disagree when an offer is due, the family keeps the place and Action needed names the class and both prices; nobody is charged a stale price.

rows.scenario: The academy's makeup rules start at the agreed defaults and a change reaches the family's cancel dialog
rows.preconditions: Signed in as Admin Tester. Aria enrolled in a term class with a session 30 hours away.
rows.steps:
1. Open the facility settings Makeups tab and read the card.
2. Change notice from 24 to 48 hours and save.
3. As Maya, tap Can't make it on the session 30 hours away and read the dialog (do not confirm). Set notice back to 24.
rows.expected: Defaults: notice 24 hours, expiry 30 days after the class ends, same program, late cancel earns off, no per-class limit, classes may not set their own values. No money value setting exists. With 48 hours the dialog reads "Cancel {day}'s session? Less than 48 hours' notice, so no makeup is earned."
rows.confirm_as: Yes: exact location of the Makeups tab in facility settings.
rows.source: QXR-598 Settings defaults, readiness 12 Nov; web#693

rows.scenario: Cancelling the same session twice never earns two makeups
rows.preconditions: Aria's session more than 24 hours away, no makeups.
rows.steps:
1. Tap Can't make it, confirm, and double-tap the confirm button.
2. Open the session again in a second tab and try to cancel again.
rows.expected: One cancel record and one makeup only. The card reads "Cancelled. 1 makeup earned, expires {date}." The second attempt changes nothing.
rows.source: QXR-598 readiness (second tap changes nothing); data#382 ALREADY_EARNED

rows.scenario: A family-cancelled athlete who turns up: Present waits for the session date, asks to confirm, removes the makeup and can be undone
rows.preconditions: Aria cancelled tomorrow's session in time and holds that makeup. Coach One on Coach web.
rows.steps:
1. Today, open tomorrow's session attendance and try to mark Aria Present.
2. On the session date, mark Aria Present and read the confirm; confirm.
3. Check Aria's makeups as Maya and her notices.
4. Change Aria back to Absent.
rows.expected: Aria shows "Cancelled by family". Present and Late are not allowed before the session date. Marking asks for a confirm ("Confirm attended"). After confirm the makeup is removed and Maya gets a notice. Changing back to Absent returns the makeup and tells the family.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: D-158 still open (makeup removed only by a confirmed Present/Late). Coach Android marks moved to QXR-1047.

rows.scenario: Next on How families pay with nothing picked does not move on and explains why
rows.preconditions: New program draft at step 2, nothing picked.
rows.steps:
1. Press Next without choosing an option.
2. Press Next a second time quickly (double click).
rows.expected: The step does not advance and the address does not change. An error summary at the top reads "Fix 1 thing before you continue." and links to the options; the message reads "Choose how families pay." Nothing is saved past step 2. Next itself is never greyed out.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: D-012 says Next stays disabled until a pick; the later QXR-899 rule (owner, 10 Nov) and PR #654 say Next is never disabled and shows the error. Script follows the PR.
rows.source: QXR-648 reconciled 11 Nov; QXR-899 one rule for both wizards; web#654; D-012

rows.scenario: A membership program's Sessions step has no session count and an always-on waitlist
rows.preconditions: Membership program draft (group Beginner, 1 a week) at Sessions.
rows.steps:
1. Read the Sessions step.
2. Fill the class size 6 to 12 and session length, press Next.
rows.expected: No number of sessions is asked. In place of the waitlist switch it reads "Membership classes always have a waitlist." The program saves with its waitlist on.

rows.scenario: An unpaid (pending) place also locks how families pay, even on a class that has ended
rows.preconditions: Term program 'U10 Fielding Term' with one class whose end date has passed and no active bookings. Desk Tester can create a pay-later/pending enrolment.
rows.steps:
1. As Desk Tester, add Leo Tester to that ended class as unpaid/pending (not paid).
2. As Admin Tester, open the program, press Edit and confirm.
3. Then cancel/reject Leo's pending booking in Enrollments and try Edit again.
rows.expected: While Leo's pending booking exists, editing is refused with "1 booking on a class that has ended is still waiting for payment or consent. Reject it in Enrollments, then edit this program." After rejecting it, the program opens for editing and How families pay reads that it can still change (no running or upcoming class has bookings).
rows.confirm_as: Yes: whether the desk can create a pending booking on an ended class in the UI, or the team seeds one.

rows.scenario: Switching a program between term and membership shows what will happen to its classes before it happens
rows.preconditions: Published term program 'U9 Switch Test' (8 sessions) with one draft class and one published, not-started class, no bookings. Membership group Beginner published.
rows.steps:
1. Press Edit on the program and confirm.
2. On How families pay read the line under the options.
3. Pick "Through a membership", choose Beginner and 1 a week, press Next.
4. Read the confirm dialog, press the keep button first, then repeat and confirm the switch.
5. Open the published class afterwards.
rows.expected: Before the switch the line reads "No class has bookings yet, so you can still change this. It locks once one does." The confirm is titled "Switch to through a membership?" and lists counts such as "{n} published classes go back to draft." and the draft class losing its term price. Keep leaves everything as it was. Confirming moves the published class back to draft. The class now has no class price and reads "Places in this class come with a membership. The family signs up from the program's page."
rows.source: QXR-648 lock and switch copy; data#391; web#683

rows.scenario: Switching back to per class, by term needs the Sessions count before any class price can be saved
rows.preconditions: The program from the previous row, now membership, no bookings.
rows.steps:
1. Edit the program, choose "Per class, by term" on How families pay.
2. Read the confirm and press "Switch to term".
3. Without saving Sessions, open one of its draft classes and try to save a price of $240.
4. Go back to the program's Sessions step, set 8 sessions, save, then save the class price again.
rows.expected: The confirm is titled "Switch to per class, by term?" with buttons "Keep membership" and "Switch to term" and says plans stay and the membership group is unlinked. The first class price save is refused with "Set the program's number of sessions on its Sessions step first, then set this class's price." After Sessions is saved, $240 saves. Publishing a class with no price is refused as price required.

rows.scenario: A membership class meets once a week
rows.preconditions: Published membership program 'Beginner Membership'.
rows.steps:
1. Add a class to it and on Schedule tick Tuesday and Thursday.
2. Save / press Next.
3. Untick Thursday and save again.
rows.expected: Two days are refused with "A membership class meets once a week. Create another class for another day." One day saves.

rows.scenario: A program named in a Pass on sale can't switch to a membership
rows.preconditions: Term program 'U12 Batting Foundations' named in a Pass that is on sale (Kayur's QXR-594 Pass), no bookings on the program's running classes.
rows.steps:
1. Edit the program and try to switch How families pay to "Through a membership".
2. In the Pass editor, try to add the membership program 'Beginner Membership' to that Pass and save.
rows.expected: The switch is refused with sentences naming the Pass and "To offer it through a membership, create a new membership program." The Pass save is refused with "A program in this Pass is joined through a membership, so a Pass can't discount it." Nothing changes on the Pass or the program.
rows.source: QXR-648 decided 11 Nov; membership#138; data#391; web#683

rows.scenario: A membership group used by a program can't be archived or lose a sessions-per-week value the program uses
rows.preconditions: Program 'Beginner Membership' linked to group Beginner at 1 a week.
rows.steps:
1. Open Memberships & Packages › Groups, open Beginner, press Archive.
2. Try to remove or deactivate the last '1 a week' plan in Beginner.
rows.expected: Archive is refused with "A program uses this group. Move it to another group or archive it first." Removing the last 1-a-week plan is refused because a program runs at 1 a week (names the program). The group and plans are unchanged.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: screen location of the Groups tab actions.

rows.scenario: A membership program set to 1 a week shows families only the group's 1-a-week plans
rows.preconditions: Group Beginner sells 1 a week and 2 a week (Quarterly and Annual). Program 'Beginner Membership' fixed at 1 a week, published, with a Tuesday class. Platform auto-renew switch OFF.
rows.steps:
1. As Maya Tester, open Programs and open 'Beginner Membership'.
2. Start signing up Aria and read the plans offered.
rows.expected: Only the group's 1-a-week plans are offered (no 2-a-week plan, no Monthly while auto-renew is off). Internal plan names are never shown to the family. Do not complete payment unless QXR-1067 is fixed (D-229).
rows.confirm_as: Yes: QXR-649 signup screens are not final (D-230); confirm this row is run now or later.

rows.scenario: Only one live class in a program may use the blank suffix
rows.preconditions: 'U12 Batting Foundations' already has one live class with a blank suffix (named just 'U12 Batting Foundations').
rows.steps:
1. Add another class to the same program and clear the suffix field. Read the help line.
2. Save.
rows.expected: With the field blank the help reads "Families see "U12 Batting Foundations". Leave it blank to use the program name." Saving is refused as the name is already taken. If the first blank-suffix class is cancelled, a blank suffix is accepted again.

rows.scenario: The whole class name stays within 255 characters; program names are capped at 200
rows.preconditions: None.
rows.steps:
1. Create (or rename) a program with a 201-character name and save Basics.
2. Rename it to exactly 200 characters and save.
3. Add a class to it and type a suffix of 53 characters (200 + ' · ' + 53 = 256). Save.
4. Shorten the suffix to 52 characters and save.
rows.expected: 201 characters is refused (program name too long). 200 saves. The 53-character suffix is refused with "Keep the suffix to 52 characters or fewer." (the limit is what the program name leaves). 52 characters saves.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: exact separator length counted (" · " is 3 characters) and the on-screen wording for the 201-character program name.
rows.source: QXR-893 What must be true; data#408 PROGRAM_NAME_TOO_LONG; web#691

rows.scenario: A class named before suffixes shows its old name as the suffix with a note
rows.preconditions: A class created before 16 Nov (before suffixes), e.g. one the team seeded, whose stored name doesn't follow '{program} · {suffix}'.
rows.steps:
1. Open that class's rename dialog.
2. Read the field and the note, then save without changing anything.
rows.expected: The field shows the old name as the suffix with the note "This class was named before suffixes. Saving renames it to "{program} · {suffix}"." After saving, the class name is composed as program plus suffix.
rows.source: QXR-893 What must be true and copy; data#408

rows.scenario: After a class is renamed, the family's Stripe checkout shows the new class name
rows.preconditions: A published term class with a price that has already been sold once (so it has a Stripe product). Admin Tester then renames its suffix to 'Tue and Thu Evening'. Aria has no place in it.
rows.steps:
1. As Maya Tester, enrol Aria in the renamed class.
2. On the Stripe checkout page read the item name, then pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242.
3. Open the receipt email and Billing.
rows.expected: The Stripe checkout line shows "{program} · Tue and Thu Evening", not the old name. The amount equals the class price. Receipt and Billing show the same amount. A failed rename never blocks the sale (it would go ahead under the old name).

rows.scenario: A failed Create keeps the draft and offers Try again
rows.preconditions: A complete program draft on the last step. Browser developer tools available to go offline.
rows.steps:
1. Switch the browser to offline.
2. Press Create program.
3. Go back online and press Try again.
rows.expected: An error banner shows, nothing typed is lost, and the button reads "Try again". Try again creates the program once.

rows.scenario: Create program is held, with its reason, while an earlier step is incomplete
rows.preconditions: A program draft where Sessions has no class size saved.
rows.steps:
1. Open the last step directly from the rail (if allowed) or reach it and read the Create button.
2. Press it.
rows.expected: Create reads "Finish {steps} to create the program." naming Sessions, the rail marks it, and pressing it does not create the program.
rows.source: QXR-900 What must be true; data#401 incompleteSteps

rows.scenario: Each step has its own address; reloading keeps the step and later steps can't be jumped to
rows.preconditions: Program draft (note its id {id}) whose furthest finished step is Sessions.
rows.steps:
1. On Sessions, reload the page.
2. Edit the address to /programs/templates/{id}/setup/prerequisites-waivers and open it.
3. Open /programs/templates/{id}/setup/waivers (an old address).
4. Open /programs/new/anything.
rows.expected: After reload you are on /programs/templates/{id}/setup/sessions with saved values. The prerequisites address sends you to /setup/curriculum. The old waivers address lands on the furthest step you may open. /programs/new/anything goes to /programs/new/basics. Steps after the furthest one show in the rail but are not links ("Finish {step} first").

rows.scenario: Leaving with unsaved changes asks first; browser Back saves the step being left
rows.preconditions: Program draft open on Curriculum.
rows.steps:
1. Type a session title and press the wizard's close control.
2. Press Keep editing, then close again and press Leave anyway.
3. Reopen, type a change, and use the browser Back button.
4. Open Create program, type a name on Basics, press browser Back.
rows.expected: Close shows "Leave without saving?" with "Your changes on this step are not saved yet.", Keep editing and Leave anyway. Keep editing keeps the text and returns focus to the close control. Leave anyway saves nothing. Browser Back from a later step saves that step once and moves. On /programs/new/basics with typed text and no draft, Back shows the same dialog and the address stays.

rows.scenario: Editing a live program with enrolled families: safe edits allowed, who-it's-for and how-families-pay locked
rows.preconditions: 'U12 Batting Foundations' live with Aria enrolled and paid.
rows.steps:
1. Press Edit and confirm.
2. Read the title and rail.
3. Change the description and save.
4. Try to change the age group or the age-at-enrollment switch on Basics.
5. Press Create to make it live again.
rows.expected: The wizard opens on Basics titled "Edit program" with every step open and no "Picked up where you left off" toast. The description saves. Age group and age rule are read-only (live enrollments). After Create the program is live again; Aria's place and Maya's payment are unchanged.

rows.scenario: When a required agreement is added to a program with enrolled children, the guardian (never the child) is asked to sign
rows.preconditions: 'U12 Batting Foundations' has Aria (10) enrolled; Sam (16, own login) is enrolled in another under-18 program. Admin attaches a new MANDATORY document to both programs. Needs the clock moved for the reminder.
rows.steps:
1. Check Maya's email and in-app notifications after the attach.
2. Check Sam's own login inbox.
3. As Coach One, open Aria's next session roster before signing (after the required-from date if the clock is moved).
4. As Maya, sign the document and reopen the roster.
rows.expected: Maya gets the notice to sign for Aria. Nothing is sent to Aria, and Sam's notice goes to Sam's guardian, not Sam. Before signing (past the required-from date) Aria is blocked on the roster and can't be marked present; after signing she is eligible. Signing alone never starts an unpaid place.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: required-from date / grace length on dev, and whether notices to a 16-year-old go to the guardian only.

rows.scenario: Curriculum shows exactly the session count from Sessions, including after the count is lowered
rows.preconditions: Term program draft with 12 sessions and plans titled on all 12.
rows.steps:
1. Open Curriculum and count the rows.
2. Go back to Sessions, set 10, confirm "Remove 2 sessions".
3. Open Curriculum again.
rows.expected: 12 rows first, with no add or remove control. Lowering asks to confirm removing 2 sessions. Then rows 1 to 10 show.

rows.scenario: Sessions with no title are allowed and flagged as unplanned on the class page
rows.preconditions: Term program with 12 sessions, rows 1 to 5 titled, rows 6 to 12 completely empty; a published class of it.
rows.steps:
1. Create the program (it should pass Curriculum).
2. Open the class page, Schedule & Sessions tab.
3. Choose a plan for upcoming session 8.
rows.expected: Create succeeds. Sessions 6 to 12 show an amber "Unplanned" pill. Above the table: "{n} upcoming sessions have no plan. Choose one here, or the coach can pick one on the session." After choosing plan 8, row 8 reads "Session 8 · {title}" and the count drops by one.

rows.scenario: Only an admin can see or change academy age groups
rows.preconditions: Coach One and Desk Tester signed in separately.
rows.steps:
1. As Coach One, look for Settings › Academy settings › Age groups and open its address directly.
2. As Desk Tester, do the same.
rows.expected: Neither can open or change age groups (the routes answer forbidden). A coach sees age groups only as labels on programs and classes.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: whether the desk role is ADMIN (ticket says ADMIN only).

rows.scenario: An age group in use can't change its ages; once archived it isn't offered for new programs
rows.preconditions: Under 12 is used by 'U12 Batting Foundations'.
rows.steps:
1. In Settings › Academy settings › Age groups, change Under 12's age to 13 and save.
2. Archive Under 12.
3. Start a new program and open the age group choice on Basics.
4. Open 'U12 Batting Foundations'.
rows.expected: The age change is refused ("Add a new age group instead"). After archiving, Under 12 is not offered on Basics, and the existing program still shows it as "Under 12 (archived)". Restore brings it back.

rows.scenario: Basics requires an age group, and the optional age rule can't go past the group
rows.preconditions: New program at Basics.
rows.steps:
1. Press Next with no age group.
2. Pick Under 12, turn on "Age at enrollment", set youngest 8 and oldest 12, press Next.
3. Set oldest 11, press Next.
4. Start an Adult program, turn the rule on with youngest 18 and oldest empty.
rows.expected: No age group is refused. Oldest 12 is refused with "The oldest age can't go past 11." in the error summary. Oldest 11 saves. Adult with youngest 18 and no oldest saves. Tiles read like "Under 12 · 11 and under", never a code or cut-off date.
rows.source: QXR-660 Basics fields and range cap; data#375

rows.scenario: Sessions needs class size, length and (for term) the waitlist choice before Next
rows.preconditions: Term program draft at Sessions, all fields empty.
rows.steps:
1. Enter only 12 sessions and press Next.
2. Enter minimum 0 and press Next.
3. Enter minimum 8 and maximum 6, press Next.
4. Enter 6 to 12, a length of 60 minutes, choose waitlist on, press Next.
rows.expected: Missing fields show "Enter the minimum class size.", "Enter the maximum class size." and "Choose whether the waitlist is on." 0 shows "The class size starts at 1." 8 to 6 is refused because the maximum can't be lower than the minimum (names 8). The valid set saves and new classes start from 6 to 12 and 60 minutes.

rows.scenario: Turning a program's waitlist off while families wait stops new joins but lets existing entries run
rows.preconditions: Term program with a full published class, waitlist on, Aria waiting in position 1.
rows.steps:
1. Edit the program, Sessions step, turn the waitlist off and read the dialog. Save.
2. As another guardian, try to join the waitlist of that class.
3. As Maya, open Aria's waitlist entry.
rows.expected: The dialog says how many are waiting. New joins are refused. Aria's entry stays and any offer runs its course. The switch is copied to every draft and published class of the program.

rows.scenario: A coach who is busy at the class's times can't be assigned, and Action needed lists any class with a busy coach
rows.preconditions: Coach Two teaches 'U10 Fielding Term · Tue' Tue 5:00 pm. A second class 'U12 Batting Foundations · Tue' Tue 5:00 pm, published, no coach.
rows.steps:
1. On the second class, assign Coach Two through today's class screens.
2. Open Action needed.
rows.expected: The assign is refused because Coach Two is busy (the web may show a generic error; note its text). Action needed lists any class whose coach is busy at its times. A lead coach flag is only a label.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: the new Coaches step screens (lead, Free/Busy list) come with QXR-901, not on dev; confirm the old class screens are the ones to test.

rows.scenario: After booking closes, a family can't start a trial or buy, but the desk and an admin-added trial still can
rows.preconditions: Term class whose booking close date has passed (set by the team via the class's enrollment window; the Schedule control comes with QXR-901). Free trial switched on for the class.
rows.steps:
1. As Maya, open the program on a desktop window and on a narrow (phone-width) window.
2. Try to start a free trial for Aria.
3. As Admin Tester, add a trial for Aria from the class roster.
rows.expected: Cards read "Booking closed" at both widths. The family trial and purchase are refused with a no-retry message; nothing is charged. The admin-added trial goes ahead.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: how to set the booking close date on dev without the QXR-901 Schedule step.

rows.scenario: A declined card on Continue charges nothing and keeps the offer open until its deadline
rows.preconditions: Open next-block offer for Aria.
rows.steps:
1. Press Continue and pay with 4000 0000 0000 0341.
2. Read the card on Aria's enrolment.
3. Pay again with 4242 4242 4242 4242 before the deadline.
rows.expected: The decline charges nothing and the place is still offered with its deadline. The second payment succeeds once; one paid invoice.

rows.scenario: Stop ends the place after the paid block with no further charge
rows.preconditions: Aria holds a paid block with an open next-block offer.
rows.steps:
1. Press Stop and confirm.
2. As Admin Tester, open the class roster.
3. Move the clock past the block end.
rows.expected: No new invoice is created. Aria keeps every session already paid for and her place ends after the block. The seat becomes free after that. If an admin stops it instead, a confirm is asked and the reason is recorded.

rows.scenario: Class Policies text follows the academy's rule and shows where families decide
rows.preconditions: Makeup notice 24 hours.
rows.steps:
1. As Maya, open a class page, then the enrol review before payment, then Help & Legal.
2. As Admin Tester, change notice to 48 hours; reopen as Maya.
rows.expected: Class Policies show on the class page, enrol review and Help & Legal, saying cancel "at least 24 hours" ahead for a make-up place, no cash value, not transferable. After the change it reads 48 hours for new enrolments.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: counsel's final wording of Class Policies is still open.

rows.scenario: A cancel by the second guardian notifies the guardians but never the child
rows.preconditions: Ravi linked to Aria without billing permission. Aria's session more than 24 hours away.
rows.steps:
1. As Ravi, cancel Aria's session in time.
2. Check Ravi's, Maya's and Aria's notifications.
3. Repeat on a session inside 24 hours.
rows.expected: Ravi can cancel. Makeup earned notice goes to Ravi (who acted) and Maya (primary). Nothing to Aria. A cancel that earns nothing sends an in-app notice to the other guardian only.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: may a guardian without billing permission cancel a session? Ticket says any guardian.

rows.scenario: A stricter rule change applies to new enrolments only; a looser one reaches everyone
rows.preconditions: Aria enrolled in a class with notice 24 hours. Leo is not yet enrolled.
rows.steps:
1. As Admin, change notice to 48 hours.
2. As Maya, cancel Aria's session 30 hours ahead (preview only).
3. Enrol Leo in the same class, preview a 30-hour cancel for Leo.
4. Change notice to 12 hours and preview both again.
rows.expected: With 48 hours Aria still earns a makeup at 30 hours (she keeps the rule from her purchase); Leo does not. With 12 hours both earn.
rows.source: QXR-598 readiness: the more generous rule

rows.scenario: Old program type and skill level no longer show anywhere, even on programs that still store them
rows.preconditions: A program created before 10 Nov that stored a type (e.g. Workshop) and a level (e.g. Advanced); Coach One teaches one of its classes.
rows.steps:
1. As Admin Tester, open Basics, the Overview tab, the Programs landing and the class program picker for that program.
2. Search Programs for 'Camp'.
3. As Coach One, open Programs (table and card view), the program detail and an athlete in the session roster.
rows.expected: No Program type, Skill, Skill level, Target level or Level label shows. The picker has the search box and Sport filter only. The landing line reads like "Cricket · Ages 9–11". 'Camp' finds only programs with Camp in the name. The coach's athlete drawer has no "Skill Level" row.

rows.scenario: Several sessions missing a title are listed together, in order, and nothing typed is lost
rows.preconditions: Term program at Curriculum; rows 3 and 7 have an activity but no title.
rows.steps: 1. Press Next.
rows.expected: Nothing is saved. The summary reads "Fix 2 things before you continue." listing session 3 then session 7, each linked to its title. Typed content stays.

rows.scenario: Age group names must be unique ignoring case; ages stay within 1 to 99; same age is allowed
rows.preconditions: Age groups list open.
rows.steps:
1. Add a group named 'under 12'.
2. Add 'Under 7' with age 0, then 100, then 1, then 99 (rename between tries).
3. Add 'Juniors' with the same age as Under 12.
4. Delete an unused group.
rows.expected: 'under 12' is refused as a duplicate. 0 and 100 are refused, 1 and 99 accepted. Same age as another group is allowed. Delete asks "Delete {group}? No program uses it. It leaves the list for good." with "Delete age group" and "Keep it".
rows.source: QXR-892 What must be true, Check 1; D-079

rows.scenario: Families see the program's age group label, never a code or cut-off date
rows.preconditions: 'U12 Batting Foundations' published with age group Under 12.
rows.steps: 1. As Maya, open Programs and the program.
rows.expected: The program shows "Under 12" (with its ages label where shown), never 'U12' as a code and never a date. Note: on dev nothing is refused to athletes by age yet (set 1 only); do not file a bug that Leo (13) is not blocked.
rows.confirm_as: Yes: QXR-660 sets 2-3 and QXR-913 (guardian Programs screen) are not on dev; confirm the guardian age refusal is not expected yet.
rows.source: data#375 "Nothing is refused to athletes in this set"; web#653; D-080

rows.scenario: With lessons switched off, families and coaches see no lesson booking
rows.preconditions: Lessons switch OFF for UAT Cricket Academy (launch state, D-227).
rows.steps:
1. As Maya, look for a Coaching tab or lesson booking.
2. As Coach One, look for lesson slots in the Schedule tab.
rows.expected: No lesson booking, slot or lesson row is offered. Lessons are off at launch; only file a defect if lesson booking IS reachable.
